# PROCESS — cand_0008 (parent cand_0001) — explainability (REQUIRED)

Capability = the spreadsheet agent's system prompt (`prompt.md`). Reader = azure/gpt-5.5 (strong).
Only `prompt.md` is editable. **Outcome of this iteration: NO prompt edit** — `prompt.md` is
byte-identical to champion cand_0001. This is an intentional, evidence-backed ceiling handback,
the THIRD independent confirmation (after cand_0004 and cand_0005) that no prompt-only edit
passes all three tests (REAL / SAFE / VERIFIED) with enough robust deterministic payoff to clear
the significance gate. Fresh diagnosis this iteration used 2 parallel read-only subagents.

## What I did
- Re-diagnosed THIS iteration's `./trajectories/` from scratch with 2 parallel read-only subagents:
  (1) the 9 deterministic always-fail sheet/cell tasks; (2) the 11 fragile/format passers, building a
  per-task × per-lever sensitivity table.
- Read the two highest-signal prior diffs (cand_0006 = highest val ever 0.656; cand_0007 = its redesign)
  and cross-referenced every candidate lever against LEDGER broke/fixed sets.

## Ranked clusters (this iteration's traces) + why each lever fails a test
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | candidate lever | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Replicate the file's own demonstrated logic (reference formula / worked example / After-sheet) | 39946, 254-34, 413-15 (0/3) | agent invents an equivalent-looking method instead of reproducing the sheet's exact convention | "reproduce the reference formula's method / worked example" | **REFUTED** — tested twice: cand_0006 (0.656, +7/−3) and cand_0007 (0.637, +4/−2), both rejected by the significance gate. cand_0007 still could not fix 39946 (its per-row `/365` + day-of-month-offset logic is too intricate for a general rule). Re-testing forbidden. |
| 2 | "Delete entire rows" via hand-compaction | 269-44, 157-4, 577-40 (0/3) | agent hand-compacts survivors and guesses shift/blank/token semantics | "use ws.delete_rows() on a working copy, then read the answer range back" | **Fails VERIFIED** — the real root causes are per-task, NOT the method: 157-4 tested the wrong columns (included the always-populated Weeknumber col); 577-40 mishandled `-`/currency-zero tokens; 269-44 is a shift/blank-representation ambiguity I cannot resolve without the gold. delete_rows fixes none of these verifiably. Also **fails SAFE**: its class includes passing 347-49 (a deletion task and the recurring noise casualty). |
| 3 | answer_position is a detached summary cell but prose says "highlight" | 254-34 (0/3) | agent applied fills, left C2 value empty | narrowed "write the computed value when the answer cell is detached from the highlighted data" | **Fails VERIFIED** — the subset that must sum to the target is a selection problem with an unknown expected scalar (sum? count? flag?); writing *a* value would still be the wrong value. cand_0004's broader form of this already broke CF_7349/CF_12196/430-43. |
| 4 | per-task logic / output ordering / datetime | 146-49 (col/row order), 18137 (datetime boundary), 30930/49237/53062 (flaky boundary logic) | distinct wrong computation per task | — | **Fails SAFE+VERIFIED** — only an overfit per-task example fixes each; no general rule. |

## Fragile-passer sensitivity (why every additive rule regresses; from subagent 2)
| lever | breaks | reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (a) reproduce reference formula | 53023, (267-18) | 53023's existing formula is the *broken* one that must be REPLACED; 267-18 must *evaluate* its formula to a value, not keep it |
| (c) coerce text→number | 347-49 | copied check-numbers/dates are strings that must stay strings |
| (d) header/full-extent read | 45300 | no header row — header logic would drop the first data row (B1) |
| (e) highlight → also write value | CF_7349, CF_12196, 430-43 | pure conditional-formatting / filter tasks; writing values overwrites the graded source data |

## The decisive gate evidence (why even a net-positive edit does not clear the bar)
- cand_0006 was net-**positive** (+0.022, fixed 7 / broke 3) and was still **REJECTED** by the
  significance gate. cand_0002 (+0.007, +7/−4) also rejected. Only cand_0001 (+0.066) ever cleared it.
- cand_0005 was a **no-op** (byte-identical prompt) yet its RESULT was fixed={139-16, 35747},
  broke={267-18, 430-43, 58484}. This PROVES ~5-6 tasks flip on pure trial noise regardless of the
  prompt. Every candidate's fixed/broke sets are dominated by this noise; the reference-formula
  lever's TRUE deterministic gain is only ~2-3 tasks — genuinely below the noise floor and the bar.

## ENVIRONMENT fault handed back (HUMAN ACTION — not prose-fixable)
- **34-5** (and likely **32023**): clock-relative "current month / as of today". The sandbox clock
  (2026-08) differs from the authoring date, so the value logic byte-matches the gold yet the
  surviving-date window scores 0. FIX REQUIRES: pin the grading sandbox clock or exclude
  time-relative tasks. No prompt edit can fix a wrong wall-clock.

## Deliberately skipped (and why)
- Reference-formula / replicate lever — REFUTED twice (cand_0006, cand_0007); re-testing forbidden.
- delete_rows method rule — fails VERIFIED (doesn't fix the real per-task bugs) and SAFE (347-49 in class).
- value-on-detached-cell (254-34) — fails VERIFIED (unknown expected scalar); broader form refuted by cand_0004.
- type-coercion (refuted cand_0002), read-scope/#N/A/deletion-fill (refuted cand_0003),
  write-value-on-format (refuted cand_0004), casing rule 4225/10281 (GT contradicts instruction),
  quote-the-VLOOKUP-formula 31420 (threatens 53023) — all previously refuted; not re-tried.
- Checklist shortening / consolidation — fixes no failing task (failures are logic, not adherence) → fails VERIFIED.

## Conclusion
The champion prompt (cand_0001) is at its ceiling for this benchmark. Remaining gains require a
NON-PROSE capability (a deterministic verifier/tool that computes-and-writes and reproduces the
sheet's own formulas) or per-task fixtures (overfit), or fixing the sandbox clock — none available
in the prompt-only edit space. Champion preserved unchanged.

## Features used
- 2 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents (deterministic-fail diagnosis + fragile-passer sensitivity table).
- Read prior diffs cand_0006/cand_0007 and cross-referenced LEDGER broke/fixed sets. No worktrees needed (no edit).
